verdict.rationale: Factory documents approvals in its runtime (factory-docs-15), tiered autonomy for which operations need confirmation (factory-docs-7), and real-time monitoring of active missions (factory-docs-28). It also lets you review diffs and merge from the App, including a web session (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-9). Nothing in the evidence shows these approvals can be done from a phone, or asynchronously while agents keep working, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: a mobile app or documented mobile-friendly approval flow, push notifications for pending decisions, and evidence that agents continue working while approvals are pending remotely.
